title: Jerk chicken
ingredients: 3 lb chicken thighs or a mix of pieces
2–4 Scotch bonnet or habanero peppers, seeded if you want less heat
steps: Blend all marinade ingredients to a paste. Coat chicken well. Marinate 4 hours or overnight.
Grill over medium heat, turning, until charred and cooked through, or roast at 425°F.
Rest 10 minutes. Serve with rice and beans.
